newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela holds Dutch priest on drugs charge.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela holds Dutch priest on drugs charge.

text.p: Venezuelan authorities have arrested a Dutch Roman Catholic priest on charges of trying to smuggle cocaine out of the country, drug officials said on Tuesday.
Father Espark Cornelis Maria was arrested Monday afternoon at Maiquetia international airport, they said.
An official from the National Guard's drug squad told Reuters he was alleged to have been carrying five pounds (two kg) of cocaine in a belt under his clothes.
Maria, 51, was in transit to Amsterdam from former Dutch colony Surinam, the official said.
